worst_flaw: Groups earn credit only for reviews that go back to the assigned reviewer within eight staffed hours. Nothing caps how much review work lands on the rotating primary, and nothing tracks author-side delays, so crediting by group could hide overload or knock-on delays on other work. Operability is also thin: there is no replayable event history or versioned policy, the appeals process has no staff beyond the pilot owner, and the rules are never shadow-tested on real past PRs before launch.
